title: decent price and quality
text: decent price and quality. I needed a set that I could leave at our condo in the lock down area.  It is very handy to have the carrying case for that purpose.  They arrived sharp, and has a sharpening stick for those with skill enough to use.  I personally use a table top sharpener.  I purchased this set for my daughter earlier this year and she loves hers.  For the price, they are a decent quality and will last for a few years.  I will update if there any issues.  They arrived quickly (we have prime) and in good condition.

product_metadata.title: Top Chef by Master Cutlery 5-Piece Chef Basic Knife Set with Nylon Carrying Case
features: Item Package Dimensions: 2.0" L x 16.13" W x 8.75" H
description: Officially licensed Bravo TV Top Chef 5-piece Knife Set (7-inch Santoku, 5-inch Santoku, 3.5-inch Paring Knife, Sharpening Stick and Nylon Carrying Case). Knives feature Ice-Tempered Stainless Steel Blades w/ precision cut sharpened cutting edges and hollow grounds to reduce sticking and laser-etched Top Chef logos on each blade. Knives and Sharpening Stick feature full steel handles w/ seamless bonded and polished bolsters and non-slip surfaces. Nylon Carrying Case seals easily and features a Top Chef Logo Metal Plate.
